assets.role: Illustrative cover for the existing bundled space shooter; not a gameplay screenshot
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: premium cover art for an existing playable arcade space shooter in PLAYLAB, used at large size on a sculptural gallery ribbon and as a game thumbnail. Create a richly art-directed cinematic pixel-art scene, landscape 3:2. A small luminous ivory-and-coral spacecraft flies over the silhouette of an ancient observatory and distant fantastical cliffside city, under a huge warm full moon in a deep violet midnight sky. Space-shooter theme: a few tiny distant enemy craft, delicate laser star trails, but calm and beautiful rather than explosive action. Foreground stone terrace, tiny wildflowers lit in amber, painterly rose and lavender clouds, atmospheric layers of dark-blue mountains and city spires. Sophisticated 16-bit pixel-art aesthetic with tightly controlled fine pixel detail, no large blocky pixels. A coherent game-world establishing shot, warm moonlight against rich violet-blue shadows, soft luminous accents, exceptionally beautiful visual hierarchy. Subject spacecraft at left-centre, moon in upper right, horizon low enough to retain recognizable composition when cropped. No text, letters, titles, logos, UI, border, watermark, poster typography, synthetic chrome, or neon-purple stock sci-fi imagery. This is original editorial game cover art, not a screenshot. At least 1536x1024.

Vibrant exquisitely detailed fine pixel-art, a small round sky-blue bird with orange beak and white belly flying LEFT OF CENTER through a gap between two glowing emerald-green vertical pipes, the near pipe at the right quarter. Indigo midnight rooftop city with tiny warm windows and magenta neon accents, rich electric blue shadows, foreground pixel sparkles, satisfying cheerful expressive bird. Strong clear graphic silhouette, collectible indie game cover art, polished restrained retro charm. Deep vivid navy background, teal and lime highlights, coral orange accent, natural pixel grid, 16-bit hand-drawn feel. Not 3D, not blurry, no screen capture UI, no score, no text, no logos, no watermark, no border. Enough room around bird for wide 1.6:1 crop. It should feel like a real crafted indie game world rather than a generic AI image.
